_note: Copy to mailing_list.json (git-ignored) and edit. One entry per scheduled email. time is local time at the area (24 h); days defaults to every day; scale is mb (Manitoba, from FWI) or cwfis; fire_behaviour adds the FBP section to the PDF (radius_km, default 10). Changes are picked up within a minute, no restart needed.
_front_alerts_note: Front watch alerts: email when RDPS forecasts a frontal wind shift at the area within within_hours. strength is strong (wind >= 30 km/h or gusts >= 50 after the shift) or any. One email per event; the weather map also shows them and can raise desktop notifications.
_fire_alerts_note: Fire alerts: email when NASA FIRMS detects a fire inside an area's drawn boundary (last 24 h, persistent industrial sources excluded). aois is a list of area ids or "all"; include_low_conf also emails low-confidence detections. Each detection is emailed once; new detections send a follow-up.
